Catalogue frame-quality scores were unavailable for the WISE frames from 2010 (cryogenic), 2010-2011 (post-cryogenic), so those frames were checked by their measured pixel noise instead.
Every SPHEREx spectrum point is unusable (538 where the target saturates the detector, 1 where too much of the target is covered by bad pixels), so there is no spectrum to judge.
The Gaia DR3 and CatWISE2020 lists were reused from the view built on 15 Nov 2026, because the catalogue services did not answer.
The SPHEREx spectrum may include light from a Gaia star (G = 19.2) that comes within 4.1 arcsec of the target, less than one SPHEREx pixel.
The SPHEREx spectrum may include light from a Gaia star (G = 19.4) that comes within 4.3 arcsec of the target, less than one SPHEREx pixel.
The target saturates some frames (W1, W2, spx-b1, spx-b2, spx-b3, spx-b4, spx-b5, spx-b6); positions there are less reliable.
